title: Protease pH window
claim_text:
1. A method for treating a protein substrate comprising contacting the substrate with a protease enzyme.
2. The method of claim 1, wherein the protease enzyme is active at pH 6-8.
3. The method of claim 1, wherein the enzyme has at least 95% identity to SEQ ID NO:9.

title: Markush enzyme composition
claim_text:
1. An enzyme composition comprising an enzyme selected from the group consisting of protease, lipase, and amylase.
2. The composition of claim 1, wherein the enzyme is formulated for industrial treatment.

title: General enzyme process
claim_text:
1. A general enzyme process comprising contacting a substrate with an enzyme.
2. The process of claim 1, wherein the enzyme is used in a conventional cleaning solution.
